experiments.purpose: Compare an early pulse with a late pulse at the same current drive and wait; tests the history-order effect.
Paired contrast against the early pulse condition.
Test whether the early-pulse effect changes with wait duration.
Paired late-pulse condition at longer wait.

prospective_contrast: At u=0.3 and h=0.5, compare histories [1,0,0,0] and [0,0,0,1]. The model predicts a response difference of early_gain-late_gain. A measured difference inconsistent with this prediction by more than 0.03 response units refutes the fitted history-order structure.

quantities.interpretation: Drive in the oldest recorded interval; its effect is separately estimated.
quantities.name: early

quantities.interpretation: Drive in the most recent recorded interval; its effect is separately estimated.
quantities.name: late

quantities.interpretation: Total adjacent drive change across the recorded sequence, a candidate descriptor of alternating history.
quantities.name: alternation

refutation_condition: Reject if dev RMSE exceeds 0.06 or if the prospective paired order contrast differs from the model prediction by more than 0.03 response units.
scientific_change: The prior additive mean-history summary fails dev validation (RMSE 0.176). Replace it with explicit oldest and newest interval contributions plus a sequence-change term. This tests whether response depends on temporal placement and alternation rather than only integrated history; the additional terms remain candidates pending held-out validation.
